rows.question: Can I submit a format other than PDF?
rows.raw: No. The course rules specify submitting one PDF file named student_id_assignment_number.pdf. A different format would not be accepted.

rows.question: Tell me how submissions after the deadline are handled
rows.raw: Late submissions are accepted within 48 hours of the deadline, with a grade penalty.

rows.question: What happens if I miss the submission deadline?
rows.raw: A late submission is accepted within 48 hours of the deadline, with a grade penalty.

rows.question: Will an assignment submitted after the deadline be accepted?
rows.raw: No. Late submissions are accepted within 48 hours of the deadline, with a grade penalty.

rows.question: When will grades be released?

rows.question: Is there a character count limit for assignments?
rows.raw: No. There is no character count limit for assignments. The only limits are the file size (maximum 5 MB) and the number of files submitted (one per student ID).

rows.question: Will I receive feedback on my submitted assignment?
rows.raw: Yes, the course website shows the level attempted and any feedback given in the "Work and complete work" section.

rows.question: Is a particular citation style required?
rows.raw: No. The course does not specify a required citation style. You may choose your own (for example, APA or Harvard).

rows.question: Do office hours require an appointment?
rows.raw: No. Questions are welcome during office hours every Tuesday from 17:00 to 18:00. An appointment is not required.
